clips.title: The story
paras: Auberdine posts an Alliance bounty for Murkdeep, blamed for a Sentinel's death and ships lost off Darkshore. The village council wants the dangerous murloc chieftain dead. Find him south along the misty coast.

The Greymist murlocs along Darkshore are usually a nuisance, but Murkdeep has turned against Auberdine. The wanted poster outside the inn names him as the killer of at least one night elf Sentinel. It also suspects him of sabotaging or wrecking two cargo vessels offshore. With ships lost and raids along the coast, the Auberdine Village Council has set a public bounty on the murloc leader.

Murkdeep lurks off the southern coast, near murloc huts clustered around a bonfire. Trespassers draw an organized defense: Greymist coastrunners and shore-crawlers surge from the surf to protect their settlement. Murkdeep then emerges alongside his vanguard to strike the intruders.

Proof of Murkdeep's death meets a grim need for the Sentinels. Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea handles the bounty payout for the council. With Greymist leadership broken, travelers and ships on the foggy Darkshore coast gain a reprieve from sabotage.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A reward is being offered for the death of the murloc "Murkdeep". This foul beast is known to be responsible for the death of at least one Sentinel, and is suspected of causing the sinking of at least two cargo vessels in the waters off Darkshore!

Murkdeep was last spotted at a hutted murloc camp south of Auberdine, and is thought to be protecting the huts there. Reward claims for this bounty should be claimed with Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Greetings adventurer - what may the Sentinels assist you with today? Perhaps you are here to inquire about the bounty on Murkdeep?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well, looks like you're here to more than just inquire! The citizens will be delighted to know that tonight they will sleep a little bit more soundly and safer.
You've acted as the executioner of justice for the people of Auberdine today, friend. For that, I would like to offer you this as a suitable reward... For a true hero of the Auberdine people.
